text: APPROVE: The per-file work moved into `MergeReportRows` and `AddBranchTotals` with the same logic, including the `IOException` swallow (the old `continue` was the last statement in the loop, so it did nothing). `ref found`/`ref hit` keep the partial totals on a mid-file IOException, and the `CHA0004` suppression is preserved. `GatherLcov` is now a single loop, well under 15, and I see no new build warnings, though I haven't built it.
